The '''2023–24 Cleveland State Vikings men's basketball team''' represented [[Cleveland State University]] during the [[2023–24 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Vikings, led by second-year head coach [[Daniyal Robinson]], played their home games at the [[Wolstein Center]] as members of the [[Horizon League]]. They finished the season 18–13, 11–9 in Horizon League play to tie for seventh place. As the No. 7 seed in the [[2024 Horizon League men's basketball tournament|Horizon League tournament]], they defeated [[2023–24 IUPUI Jaguars men's basketball team|IUPUI]] and [[2023–24 Youngstown State Penguins men's basketball team|Youngstown State]] before losing to [[2023–24 Oakland Golden Grizzlies men's basketball team|Oakland]] in the semifinals. The Vikings received an automatic bid to the [[2024 College Basketball Invitational|College Basketball Invitational (CBI)]], defeating [[2023–24 Northern Colorado Bears men's basketball team|Northern Colorado]] in the first round before falling to [[2023–24 High Point Panthers men's basketball team|High Point]] in the quarterfinals, bringing their overall record to 21–15.

==Previous season==
The [[2022–23 Cleveland State Vikings men's basketball team|Vikings]] finished the [[2022–23 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2022–23 season]] 21–14, 14–6 in [[2022–23 Horizon League men's basketball season|Horizon League play]] to finish in three-way tie for second place.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://horizonleague.org/standings.aspx?standings=75|title=2022-23 Men's Basketball Standings|work=Horizon League|access-date=November 14, 2023|language=en}}</ref> In the [[2023 Horizon League men's basketball tournament|Horizon League tournament]], they defeated [[2022–23 Robert Morris Colonials men's basketball team|Robert Morris]] in the quarterfinals<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.csuvikings.com/sports/m-baskbl/2022-23/releases/202303031ws0ry|title=Viking Victory: Cleveland State Men's Basketball Advances to Horizon League Semifinals with Thrilling Win over Robert Morris|website=Cleveland State University|access-date=November 14, 2023}}</ref> and [[2022–23 Milwaukee Panthers men's basketball team|Milwaukee]] in the semifinals<ref>{{Cite to reach finals of Horizon League Tournament|work=Cleveland.com|access-date=November 14, 2023|language=en}}</ref> before falling to [[2022–23 Northern Kentucky Norse men's basketball team|Northern
